title: Research Task DAG (v3: nested WBS tree + focus + CWL-style I/O)
description: Directed task tree + dataflow layer. Lives at state/tasks/graph*.json. ONLY machine truth; TASKS*.md and *board*.html are auto-generated mirrors (never hand-edit). v3 additive over v2 (schema_version 2.0|3.0, new fields optional → v2 files stay valid). Owns: containment (parent), directed deps (depends_on), dispatch (owner), status, missing_info, grouping (component, optional), CWL-style I/O (optional). verdict/evidence/narrative stay in cycle/ledger/memory via links. Validated by scripts/tasks/task_graph.py (no external jsonschema dep).

focus.description: v3: id of the task currently being solved. UI auto-expands the path to it and collapses other branches.

components.description: v2 main-task layer (optional in v3; v3 uses the parent tree instead).

parent.description: v3: containment parent (X is a subtask of parent). null/absent = root. Builds the WBS tree. Distinct from depends_on (sequence).

kind.description: milestone = container/parent task (no I/O, excluded from program-flowchart). data/compute appear in the program-flowchart.

depends_on.description: REQUIRED predecessor task ids (sequence; drive ready/blocked). NOT containment. Optional task inputs go in io.inputs required:false and are NOT here.

io.description: Optional CWL-style dataflow. Omit for milestone/container nodes.

ref.description: Upstream task id producing this input, or null for external/raw data.

worktree.description: v3.3 F1: which git worktree this task is worked in (path).

branch.description: v3.3 F1: which git branch this task is worked in (isolation; reuses git_branch_commit_guard governance).

observe.description: v3.1: what to look at to observe/verify this task (figures / files / materials).

headline.description: v3.2 L0: one-line 重點結論 (always shown). Fallback = title.

summary.description: v3.2 L1: 2-3 sentence 摘要 (always shown). Fallback = notes.

goal.description: v3.4: 目標/完成判準 (done-criteria) — 做完長什麼樣、怎判定 (6 維確認用).

is_gate.description: v3.5: 標記為 OPEN 決策 gate（即使掛在 topic 領域下，仍會被『決策 gates 彙整』跨切視圖列出）.

problem.description: v3.1: if this task hit a problem. LINK to existing machinery — do not reinvent. ref = path to a postmortem / NEGATIVE ledger entry.

ref.description: InterSubMod/-prefixed postmortem path or ledger entry id

fix_child.description: id of the child task created to fix it

reopen_threshold.description: v3.3 F5: condition under which this can be retried (aligns feedback_productive_failure_reopen_threshold).

verify.description: v3.1/3.3: how this task's output is verified + the recorded result. LINK to run-evaluator / cycle eval — do not reinvent the verification algorithm.

ref.description: cycle eval path / run-evaluator artifact / skill name

result.description: v3.3 F4: recorded outcome (set by verify-result helper).

evidence.description: v3.3 F4: path to evaluation.json / report supporting the result.

verified_at.description: v3.3 F4: when result was recorded.

on_fail.description: v3.1: verification-failure feedback (usually: add a child fix task + link a postmortem).

handoff.description: v3.3 F2: AI handoff package (CLAUDE.md §8 return-contract). Lets another AI confirm & continue.
